name: Tralalero Tralala
blurb: The AI-generated shark in Nike sneakers that kicked off Italian brainrot in January 2025
title: Tralalero Tralala Meme: Meaning, Origin & Trend
description: Tralalero Tralala is an AI-generated shark in Nike sneakers set to an Italian voice clip; it went viral on TikTok in January 2025.
h1: What is the Tralalero Tralala meme?
answer: Tralalero Tralala is an AI-generated image of a three-legged shark wearing Nike sneakers, paired with an Italian voice clip that opens "Tralalero tralala". The audio surfaced on TikTok in early January 2025, and on 13 January a video matching it to the sneaker shark passed 7 million plays. It is usually called the first Italian brainrot character, the one that set the template of absurd AI creature plus Italian narration.

body: The picture is a realistic-looking shark standing on three legs, each in a Nike-style sneaker. The audio is a fast Italian monologue that rhymes nonsense about the shark and its family. Later fan lore made him an athlete who runs at superhuman speed.

body.note: The shark is an AI-generated image. The original audio includes Italian blasphemy and swearing; some Muslim users objected, while others noted that this kind of cursing is a common, careless filler in casual Italian. Many remixes use cleaned-up versions.

head: Date
Event
rows: The sound is first posted by TikTok account @eZburger401, later banned; early videos using it appear around 8–10 January.
@amoamimandy.1a posts an AI image of a shark in Nike shoes with the audio; it passes 7 million plays.
A repost by @billy_pan17 reaches more than 20 million plays in three weeks.
A phonk remix spreads through anime and football edits; Know Your Meme logs the meme on 17 February.
"Los Tralaleritos", baby versions of the shark and his friends, start appearing, and the shark is paired with Ballerina Cappuccina in fan lore.

ul: Singing "tralalero tralala" as a nonsense chant, often to annoy siblings or classmates.
Character battles and tier lists where the sneaker shark is ranked against Tung Tung Tung Sahur or Bombardiro Crocodilo.
Fan-made relationships, for example the storyline where he is Ballerina Cappuccina's love interest.
Plush toys, Roblox avatars and drawings of the shark in sneakers.

body: Tralalero Tralala is the classic that started it all and still sits near the top of every brainrot ranking, but the spotlight moved to later characters like Tung Tung Tung Sahur. Wikipedia also notes that the nonsense phrase appeared earlier, in 2023 memes, before the shark gave it a face.

faq.a: Nothing. It is sing-song filler like "tra-la-la". The rest of the original Italian audio is rhyming nonsense with some swearing.

faq.q: Is the Tralalero Tralala shark real?
faq.a: No. It is an AI-generated image of a shark with legs and Nike sneakers, not a real animal or a drawn cartoon.

faq.q: Was Tralalero Tralala the first Italian brainrot?
faq.a: It is widely considered the first: its January 2025 TikTok videos set the format that later characters copied.
